hero.title: Strategic thinking
hero.lead:
We are curious, analytical and critical minds.

We inhabit the space that is yet to be defined. We integrate judgement and future vision to help make decisions in complex environments.

intro.statement: We bring clarity to identify relevant opportunities and build value propositions that endure over time.
intro.clients: Bershka — Ecoembes — Mahou — Frit Ravich — Serveo  —

services.name: Strategic design
services.description: We define the problem before solving it. We analyse the business context, people's needs and market opportunities to build a clear strategic direction.

services.name: Strategic foresight
services.description: We navigate the complexity of the present to design possible futures. We identify signals of change to build plausible and desirable scenarios and transform them into concrete product, business and experience opportunities.

services.name: Brand strategy
services.description: We communicate with clarity. We define purpose, positioning and narratives to translate them consistently into brands' language, design and experience.

services.name: Innovation strategies
services.description: We build strategies connected to real business objectives. We identify value opportunities and design viable exploration models so that innovation generates measurable impact.

hero.title: Experience design
hero.lead:
We research, design and validate.

We operate the ground where ideas become tangible. We bring evidence and methodological rigour to scale solutions with judgement.

intro.statement: We activate authentic and coherent solutions based on our own methodologies and artificial intelligence tools applied with human judgement.
intro.clients: CatSalut — Imagin — Massimo Dutti — Tecnocasa — ING — Ricoh  —

services.name: Product and Service Design
services.description: We understand people, we design for them. We design digital, physical and hybrid experiences, from concept definition to interaction detail, ensuring that every design decision responds to a real need and a clear business objective.

services.name: Product validation
services.description: Validate to decide with confidence. We validate products and services at any stage — from concept to production — to reduce risk before scaling. We replace assumptions with evidence, optimising resources and ensuring every correction happens at the right moment.

services.name: Clonica© — Research with synthetic users
services.description: Research with people is the origin; artificial intelligence is the accelerator. Clonica© is our proprietary platform of synthetic users trained on real primary research. They reflect behaviours, contexts and contradictions with 93% similarity. They don't replace people: they expand our capacity to understand them, enabling validation and testing at any stage without the time and cost barriers of traditional research.
deliverables: Attitudinal archetypes and segments with AI

services.name: Insight Panel© — User recruitment for research
services.description: Immediate access to real people. Our own user acquisition and management service for qualitative and quantitative studies. We handle the entire process: identification, recruitment and coordination so your team can focus on extracting learnings, not managing logistics.

hero.title: Cultural transformation
hero.lead:
We facilitate, drive and disseminate.

We inhabit change from within to help organisations think, work and relate to the future. The hardest transformation isn't technological or structural — it's cultural.

intro.statement: We drive change by integrating mindsets that amplify talent. We develop the internal capacity for teams to advance autonomously.

services.name: Organisational Culture
services.description: Organisations change when the people who form them change, not just processes or tools. We accompany teams and organisations in cultural transformation processes, from defining a new way of working to activating change in the day-to-day. An accompaniment that respects what already exists and builds on it, without imposing external models that don't fit the internal reality.

services.name: Augmented Organisations
services.description: Amplify talent, don't replace it. An augmented organisation isn't an automated organisation: it's one where people work better because artificial intelligence amplifies their capacity to think, decide and create. We help organisations make that leap, not from technology, but from people.

services.name: Bootcamps and workshops
services.description: Learning by doing is the fastest way for a team to change how it thinks and works. We design and facilitate intensive bespoke experiences for companies that need to activate specific capabilities, explore innovation opportunities, anticipate futures or integrate generative AI into their way of working. Disruptive innovation. Exploring unconventional business opportunities, breaking established mental models and generating ideas with transformative potential. Futures design. Building medium and long-term scenarios to make better decisions today, using applied foresight methodologies. Applied generative AI. Practical sessions to generate ideas and solutions using generative AI tools, always connected to real problems faced by the team.

manifiesto.title: AI Manifesto
manifiesto.body1: We understand AI not as an end, but as a responsibility. We use it to expand judgement, not to replace it; to explore and design better, not faster.
manifiesto.body2: We commit to applying it with rigour, ethical sense and critical thinking to detect its biases and safeguard human meaning and real impact.
